messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime.batch_queue.tail_ms > 1000ms on canary-slice (policy=canary-release-b6). URL: https://metrics.redwood.ai/alerts/1976004321 - fired at 2026-03-15T03:12:01Z

lina-oncall: i'm paged, on it. seeing p95 jump on gen endpoints. starting with process logs and kernel selection traces.

omar-sre: i can see a coordinated spike in prefetch fanout right after the rollout. batch queue length jumps align with `prefetch.shard_fanout=expanded`.

devin-runtime: rel-2026-03-15-b6 enabled the experimental prefetch optimizer + new kernel selector heuristics. possible combinatorial issue where prefetch increases active KV footprint causing fallback kernels + slower attention kernels.

support-olga: receiving inbound chat from a customer (acct-7721) complaining about 3s+ responses since ~03:15 UTC. no HTTP 5xx.

lina-oncall: quick triage: errors negligible, latency and throughput impacted. probable root: prefetch + kernel selector causing heavy CPU/GPU scheduling and kernel fallback.

omar-sre: node telemetry: GPUs stable, but process-level `kernel_select` logs show repeated `selected: optimized_conv_v2` then immediate `fallback->generic_attention` for ~30% of calls. grep output: ```grep -n "fallback->" /var/log/runtime/kernel_select.log | tail -n 50```

devin-runtime: canary gating - flipping feature flag to stop the prefetch optimizer on canary. @deploy-bot flip request now.

deploy-bot: executing `redwood ff set prefetch-optimizer false --env prod --target canary`

deploy-bot: done at 2026-03-15T03:22:18Z.

lina-oncall: after ff flip, kernel fallback rate dropped ~70% but batch tail still elevated. looks like queued requests during the degraded window are causing head-of-line blocking.

omar-sre: increasing runtime workers on canary pool to help drain backlog: `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-canary --replicas=12` (issued).

lina-oncall: plan: 1) hold rollout, 2) flip kill-switch for prefetch globally if impact persists, 3) revert canary to stable rel-2026-03-01-stable if queue doesn't subside in 10m. initiating revert now to be safe.

deploy-bot: starting rollback: `deploy revert --release rel-2026-03-15-b6 --target canary --percent 100`

qa-anya: note: many requests in the queue were holding KV prefixes. clearing prefix cache after revert will reduce stall: `curl -X POST http://runtime-canary/admin/cache/clear?prefix=kv_prefetch_`

lina-oncall: rollback completed at 03:32:01Z per deploy logs. immediate p95 drop from 2.7s -> 650ms over ~4m. still above normal baseline (~120ms).

omar-sre: kernel fallback traces nearly gone. backlog draining but seeing slow drain due to head-of-line. suggestion: enable small soft-drop threshold for requests older than 5s to avoid long-lived tail.

support-olga: notified acct-7721 with update and request ids. customer confirmed improved performance around 03:36 UTC.

product-evan: please capture all affected request ids and quantify SLO exposure window. we'll prepare customer comms if any SLO missed.

lina-oncall: captured request samples and uploaded to incident store: ids [r:8821, r:8830, r:8839, r:8902]. linking to incident ticket https://incidents.redwood.ai/1976004321-doc

devin-runtime: quick follow-ups: - disable prefetch optimizer by default until compatibility matrix added - add canary check to kernel selector to skip `optimized_conv_v2` when model variant `attention_layout` != `optimized` - add alert for sudden prefetch_fanout delta > 50%

omar-sre: operational actions done: scaled canary, cache clear issued at 03:35:10Z, rollback full, killed feature on canary.

henry-nightoncall: i'm taking over at 04:00 UTC. handoff notes: rollback done, queue draining, kernel fallback rare, customer notified, postmortem owner @product-evan.

lina-oncall: assigning postmortem: @product-evan will own RCA. initial severity: SEV=high -> set P1 at 03:12:05Z. degraded -> P2 at 03:36:30Z after rollback.

product-evan: ack. i'll coordinate with runtime and SRE to draft RCA, include a small test harness to reproduce prefetch + kernel selector interaction. target deliverable: 72h draft.

lina-oncall: remaining actions added to tracker: 1) add kernel selector canary gate 2) add prefetch fanout alert 3) follow up customer comms if SLO breached 4) enforce soft-drop policy for >5s queued requests.

henry-nightoncall: thanks team, will monitor until metric returns to baseline. :thumbsup:
